rationale: The repository is licensed under Apache License 2.0 (OSI-approved, permissive). The LICENSE file contains the full Apache-2.0 text plus an appended 'Attribution Requirement' section specifying a custom attribution notice to UncleCode/Crawl4AI. This attribution requirement is consistent with Apache-2.0 Section 4's allowance for additional attribution notices. The pyproject.toml (line 11) and setup.py (line 52) both declare license='Apache-2.0'. Both README files confirm Apache-2.0 licensing.
